example_name: Drawing Robot with Custom Pen Tool
user_request_examples: Create a robot that can draw shapes on a vertical surface
Set up a simulation with a pen tool for writing
Make a robot trace a path on a whiteboard
Build a precision drawing system with contact control
scenario_description: A 7-DOF IIWA robot equipped with a custom pen end-effector draws shapes on a vertical whiteboard. This scenario demonstrates precision contact control, custom tool attachment, and trajectory planning for artistic or writing tasks.

robot.reason: 7-DOF provides redundancy for vertical workspace orientation control

complexity_factors.custom_tool_attachment: Requires modeling pen as separate body with fixed joint
complexity_factors.contact_control: Must maintain light contact force with surface
complexity_factors.vertical_orientation: End-effector orientation constrained to approach perpendicular to surface
complexity_factors.precision_trajectory: Sub-millimeter accuracy required for clean lines
complexity_factors.redundancy_resolution: 7-DOF robot requires null-space control or cost function

tasks: Model pen tool as separate body
Attach pen to robot end-effector with fixed joint

constraints.position: Pen tip follows 2D path projected onto surface
constraints.orientation: Pen axis perpendicular to surface (normal contact)

implementation_options: Pure position control with small penetration

method_1_fixed_joint.description: Model pen as rigid body, fixed joint to iiwa_link_7

method_2_drake_attachment.description: Use plant.WeldFrames() to attach pen frame to robot

hydroelastic_contact.reason: Soft pen tip, stiffer surface for realistic contact

inverse_kinematics.orientation_constraint: Pen axis aligned with surface normal

visualization.trace_drawing: Log pen tip trajectory and visualize as line strip
visualization.force_display: Show contact force as arrow in Meshcat

expected_behavior.initialization: Robot moves to home position above workspace
expected_behavior.approach: Robot moves pen to start position with light contact
expected_behavior.drawing: Robot traces path while maintaining contact force
expected_behavior.transitions: Pen lifts slightly between disconnected shapes
expected_behavior.completion: Robot returns to home position, pen lifted

validation_criteria.path_accuracy: Drawn path within 2mm of desired path
validation_criteria.contact_maintenance: Contact force 0.5-1.5N for >95% of drawing time
validation_criteria.orientation_accuracy: Pen angle within 5° of surface normal

contact_instability.symptom: Pen bounces or chatters on surface

solutions: Add posture cost to avoid singularities
Use sequential IK with intermediate waypoints

extensions.force_feedback: Use contact force sensor for adaptive pressure
extensions.3d_surface: Draw on curved surfaces with normal estimation
extensions.vision_guided: Camera feedback to trace existing patterns
extensions.dual_arm: One arm holds object, other draws on it

learning_outcomes.custom_end_effector_modeling: How to add custom tools to standard robots
learning_outcomes.contact_control: Managing contact forces for precision tasks
learning_outcomes.trajectory_generation: Converting geometric shapes to robot paths
